reader_summary.overview: This is the next cycle (Q1 2020) of Hustlin' Tech , a podcast series (from the a16z Podcast) about technology platforms that create opportunities for people. Recorded right before the coronavirus pandemic, these next 3 episodes touch on many things that are top of mind right now: from the profession of nursing. Episode #4, “The Hustler’s Guide to Nursing Jobs” features: Iman Abuzeid, MD, CEO and co-founder of Incredible Health .
